description: Explicit no-surface allowlist (issue #2893 acceptance criteria): every capability key in capability-keys.v1.json must have >=1 feature-catalog.json entry OR appear here with a reviewed reason. These are all existing FeatureCatalog Pro/Enterprise entitlement keys that gate a configuration value, a cross-cutting behavior, a background job, or an SDK/MCP-only surface rather than a distinct catalogued HTTP route.

reasonCodes.config-flag: Gates a parameter or configuration value on an existing routed capability, not a distinct route.
reasonCodes.cross-cutting-gate: A policy/validation layer applied across several existing routes.
reasonCodes.cross-cutting-default: Applies automatically as a default behavior, not a distinct route.
reasonCodes.ops-background-job: An operational background job or scheduled task, not an HTTP route.
reasonCodes.sdk-only: Exposed to SDKs/MCP tooling without a distinct catalogued HTTP route in this slice.

noSurfaceCapabilities.reason: Validation-layer gate applied across several existing MCP/spec routes rather than a distinct route of its own; see ai.spec-apply, ai.grounding, ai.workflow-generation for the gated route surfaces.
Human-in-the-loop approval policy layered over ai.agent-operations routes; no distinct route of its own.
Spec-apply execution is invoked via MCP tool call and internal job submission, not a distinct catalogued HTTP route in this slice.
Workflow/content generation is invoked via MCP tool call, not a distinct catalogued HTTP route in this slice.
